description:
Local OpenAI-compatible router that aggregates free LLM providers.

FreeLLMAPI aggregates the free tiers of dozens of LLM providers, plus custom OpenAI-compatible chat, embedding, image, and audio endpoints, behind a single /v1 API.

A router picks the best available model for each request, falls over to the next provider when one is rate-limited, and tracks per-key usage so you stay under every free-tier cap. Provider keys are stored encrypted, and the router refreshes its model catalog from a signed feed. Built for personal use only; each provider's terms of service apply.
Fixes
- Agents → Connect to FreeLLMAPI (OpenCode): Connect now also removes an old FreeLLMAPI key or address from OpenCode's other config files (opencode.jsonc, config.json, or an opencode.json in the home folder). Before, a key entered there by hand overrode the new one, so Connect showed "Configuration saved" but every message failed with "Invalid API key". (#2119)
- Clearer error for a licence key: if a tool sends the licence key (fla_…) instead of the Unified API key, the error now says so and names the right key. (#2119)
- Failover after a connection reset: when a provider resets the connection, that key is skipped on all of the provider's models for 90 seconds, so the next requests go straight to a working provider. When failover cannot help, the error says why. (#2080, #2114)
- Images without a vision model: a request with an image (in any turn) now gets a clear 422 no_vision_model instead of a misleading 429, on /v1/chat/completions, /v1/messages and /v1/responses. (#2061, #2062, #2115)
- Microsoft Store: new releases no longer cancel the version that Microsoft is still certifying, so Store installs get updates again. (#2103, #2113)
